decisions.reason: The source change concerns continuation after connected-wallet USDC approval; the Transak fiat flow uses a distinct card-to-USDC pathway and remains unchanged.
The USDC approval-to-mint change does not apply to ETH, which has no approval transaction; the distinct ETH no-NFT outcome is already represented by its same-message runtime failure.
Continuation after USDC wallet approval does not change automatic wallet creation, custody, holdings, or access paths for fiat buyers.
The source changes the USDC transaction sequence, not the mint price or allocation of sale proceeds.
The post-approval execution requirement does not alter currency disclosure or the requirement to provide an ETH/USDC selector.
The USDC approval-to-mint continuation does not change the availability, placement, presets, or custom behavior of mint tipping.
The FAQ state does not describe the connected-wallet USDC approval sequence, and the runtime report does not require any FAQ copy change.
The source change concerns completing a USDC mint after approval and does not alter badge triggers, milestones, or on-chain badge recording.
The USDC wallet-mint sequence has no necessary effect on the landing-page book cover's placement, size, crop, or visibility.
The source changes mint execution after USDC approval, not hero copy, layout, CTA presentation, or visual emphasis.
The About page does not specify the USDC approval transaction sequence, and no content revision is entailed by this source decision.
The connected-wallet USDC mint sequence does not change post-mint ebook gating, ownership verification, encryption, or viewer access.
